components.gap: The source's Remark on p. 26 gives a direct argument for the case p = q = 2: 0 <= int (f + theta g)^2 dmu = int f^2 + theta (2 int fg) + theta^2 int g^2 for every theta, so the quadratic has at most one real root and b^2 - 4ac <= 0.
